stage1_ingestion.case_summary: An employee abused a trusted financial role to gain unauthorised access to company financial resources and diverted organisational funds for personal benefit over an extended period.
stage1_ingestion.screening_note: a trusted financial employee, alleged intentional wire fraud, access to employer bank accounts, unauthorized electronic payments and company checks, affected organisational funds/services, and a personal financial benefit.  Catalyst is coded as unknown because the source does not identify a specific trigger, grievance, pressure event, or opportunity-discovery event. Psychological state, personality characteristics, attitude toward work, historical behaviour, and organisational vulnerability are coded as unknown as insufficient evidence.
